player_prompt.intro:
Mo yeke Player {player_id} na ndöngö tî Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma tî {num_rounds} ndöngö.

Kötä gbätä:
- Mbëtï na lê ndöngö, mo yeke {total_conversation_rounds} ndöngö zo kûê ndêngê.
- Pëpe mbëtï, bâa zo kûê cooperate to defect.

Matrice tî Kotä (zo gbätä ndöngö):
- Bâa Cooperate ➜ {cooperate_reward} kôo
- Bâa Defect ➜ {mutual_defect_reward} kôo
- Ömë Defect, ömë Cooperate ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

Kûê ndêngê:
- Na lê ndöngö tî kotä: kûê ndêngê tî zo kûê.
- Na ndöngö tî gbätä: kûê '[Cooperate]' to '[Defect]' (gbätä tî kotä). Mo yeke kûê ndêngê zo gbätä mbëtï/pëpe token.

phases.conversation_finished: Kolînga êkî kôta pîri ngûnda {round}. Sînga na kötä '[Cooperate]' tô '[Defect]' ndro tôngö {{}}.

outcome.round_both_cooperate: Bala o kûsi ôko na bala.
outcome.round_both_defect: Ala use kue azia lege ti ala.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Zo ti ngia 0 amû maboko na e, zo ti ngia 1 akpe.
